bookings_time_range.name: bookings_time_range
bookings_time_range.value: ("bookings"."starts_at" IS NULL AND "bookings"."ends_at" IS NULL) OR ("bookings"."ends_at" > "bookings"."starts_at")

bookings_confirmed_has_time.name: bookings_confirmed_has_time
bookings_confirmed_has_time.value: "bookings"."status"::text NOT IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'no_show') OR "bookings"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL

center_services_price_v2.name: center_services_price_v2
center_services_price_v2.value: ("center_services"."price_mode"::text = 'quote' AND "center_services"."price_egp" IS NULL AND "center_services"."price_max_egp" IS NULL) OR ("center_services"."price_mode"::text = 'fixed' AND "center_services"."price_egp" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND "center_services"."price_max_egp" IS NULL) OR ("center_services"."price_mode"::text = 'estimate' AND "center_services"."price_egp" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND ("center_services"."price_max_egp" IS NULL OR "center_services"."price_max_egp" BETWEEN "center_services"."price_egp" AND 1000000))

commission_agreements_terms.name: commission_agreements_terms
commission_agreements_terms.value: ("commission_agreements"."basis"::text = 'percent' AND "commission_agreements"."percent_bps" BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND "commission_agreements"."fixed_egp" IS NULL) OR ("commission_agreements"."basis"::text = 'fixed' AND "commission_agreements"."fixed_egp" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 AND "commission_agreements"."percent_bps" IS NULL)

notifications_unread_dedupe_idx.name: notifications_unread_dedupe_idx
notifications_unread_dedupe_idx.where: "notifications"."read_at" IS NULL AND "notifications"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL

reports_has_target.name: reports_has_target
reports_has_target.value: "reports"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL OR "reports"."reported_user_id" IS NOT NULL

service_centers_coords.name: service_centers_coords
service_centers_coords.value: ("service_centers"."latitude" IS NULL AND "service_centers"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("service_centers"."latitude" BETWEEN 21 AND 32 AND "service_centers"."longitude" BETWEEN 24 AND 37)
